scope: Userspace execution of the frozen Linux software hweight32 body and HIA objects; not Kbuild, a guest, whole-kernel performance, or an NDU experiment.
order: All 24 permutations of four arms, lexicographic, one permutation per block
correctness: Every process first checks every input against an independent bit loop and checks both register-preserving routes with the existing ABI probe.
profile_config:
CONFIG_X86_64=y
CONFIG_64BIT=y
CONFIG_CC_IS_CLANG=y
CONFIG_MITIGATION_RETHUNK=y
CONFIG_X86_KERNEL_IBT=y
CONFIG_FUNCTION_ALIGNMENT=16
config_scope: Explicit native object profile fixture, not a resolved Linux .config
thunk_scope: Common host-only return thunk stub; not Linux mitigation performance
affinity: One explicit allowed CPU for all trials; affinity does not reserve that CPU
failure_rule: Every planned cell retained. A correctness failure invalidates the comparison; no replacement or best-of retry.
hardware_rule: The hardware arm is executed only if CPUID reports POPCNT; otherwise retain NOT_RUN_UNSUPPORTED_CPU.
measurement: Monotonic wall and process CPU clocks surround exactly the same loop. Input setup, oracle checks, ABI checks and startup remain outside the timed loop and inside outer lifecycle cost.
statistics: Report raw cells, per-arm median, and paired block ratios. The sample is one shared host; no production or whole-system inference.
memory: No whole-system or peak-memory claim from child ru_maxrss.
